thesis: Quarterly conversion improved, but neither side has primary commodity, production and cash evidence to establish repeatability or cycle reversal. The 6% H1 growth is a more conservative anchor than 67.2% Q2 growth. Neutral reflects genuine improvement with limited evidence quality.
strongest_counterexample: Q2 profit/revenue rose to 10.54% from 7.03%, NAV/share increased and quarterly dividend rose to 5 sen, giving actual conversion and distribution evidence.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable half-year reports owners-profit growth above the observed 6% with positive post-investment cash and verified production/selling-price support, resolving the principal repeatability objection.
A subsequent comparable Q2 profit/revenue ratio below the observed prior-year 7.03% would invalidate the retained conversion improvement.
evidence_gaps: Original primary exchange attachments were blocked; accessible figures are from an issuer-authored mirror.
Verified CPO prices, production/harvest, costs, current borrowing and FCF.
decisive_factors: H1 profit/revenue 7.51% differs from strong Q2.
0.2999 times average volume and negative MACD do not confirm recovery.
